text:
maria_support: Heads-up — MerchantX onboarding is failing during SSO exchange, ~40% of attempts return 500s, customer is blocked. Ticket #12345.
alex_csm: Copy. Can you confirm whether any data loss or just auth failures?
maria_support: Just auth. Error looks like token validation failures from IdP. Quick snippet from logs:\n```\nERROR oidc: invalid_grant: token expired or mismatch\n```\nchris_se: I'll reproduce in staging and try increasing the token refresh tolerance. Give me 15m.
sasha_ops: I'm going to open an incident channel and set up a bridge. ops-bot: Incident channel created -> #incident-merchantx-1755550000
alex_csm: Comms plan (short): 1) Email MerchantX primary + tech lead within 30m acknowledging impact and workaround. 2) Provide step-by-step temporary workaround to clear sessions. 3) Hourly status updates until resolved. 4) Postmortem + renewal health note after fix. I can draft the email.
maria_support: Support will keep triaging and share logs/mitigation. Once SE confirms patch on canary, we'll hand off to CS for continued external comms and renewal flag.
chris_se: Canary patch deployed at 11:10, testing auth flows now. If green, I'll promote to prod in a rolling push (3 pods). ETA ~15m.
maria_support: Workaround for CS to share with customer: "Sign out of all MerchantX sessions, wait 60s, sign back in. If using SSO, ask IdP admin to ensure token lifetime >= 10m." Please add to the email.
alex_csm: Draft complete — @maria_support can you send with me cc'd? Subject: MerchantX — onboarding interruption and immediate steps
maria_support: Sent to contacts (cc @alex_csm). Email included workaround and ETA for fix. :email:
ops-bot: Bridge scheduled: 11:05 UTC — 12:05 UTC. Join: <https://meet.redwood/incident/merchantx>
sasha_ops: Added a temporary monitor: alert if SSO error rate > 10% for 5m. Also added a rollback play if promotion fails.
alex_csm: If fix not in 2h propose credits + exec outreach. Tagging @vp_cs for awareness in the follow-up doc.
chris_se: Canary is green, rolling to prod now. I'll post roll logs to the incident channel.
maria_support: Thanks team — support will continue to observe for 1 hour after rollout then formally hand to CS for renewal/relationship follow-up. :thumbsup:
alex_csm: After stable, I'll coordinate postmortem and capture action items: monitoring thresholds, SSO runbook, customer-facing FAQ. Will add to the renewal risk tracker.
ops-bot: Incident resolved -> status: monitoring. Channel will remain open for 24h.
alex_csm: Closing loop here — next steps: postmortem doc + customer summary by EOD, daily checks for 3 days. Thanks everyone!
